issues.explanation: In this context, 封谞等 are the people being imprisoned; “to imprison” is an active transitive gloss and can mislead the learner about the clause.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: "to be imprisoned; to be put in jail"

issues.explanation: Here 等 after 封谞 means “and others,” not a pluralizing suffix. Calling it a plural marker gives the learner the wrong grammatical function.
issues.suggested_fix: pattern: "suffix meaning ‘and others’"; meaning_en: "indicates additional people in the group"
